title: Version 1.24.0
body:
Version 1.24.0

July 13th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Plane Schematic (1x1x0)
  • Added Intersection Wedge Schematic
  • Added Angled Corner Cylinder Wedge Schematic
  • Added resizeable Sliding Door

Changes:

  • Crates now have Stat details
  • Vinyl Players now have Stat details
  • ACTUALLY removed Crash Dummy now... (kinder)

Bug Fixes:

  • Crates can now drag ores
  • Crates now wait for player data before welding
  • Fixed Gramophone auto eject error, which was rendering Gramophone unusable.
  • Fixed Vinyl length display in Statistic Tool
  • Fixed client error from plot being unloaded
  • Vehicles will now update speed if trailers are attached or detached whilst still driving
